## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: required vehicle equipment, lights, tires and glass
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The required-equipment diagram on the first page of the chapter was read from extracted labels only, which repeat some items (two bumpers, two turn signals); the dossier lists each item once and adds no equipment the labels do not name [A01].
The penny test is described as a wear check; the dossier states only the legal tread limit and the pass condition printed in the manual and does not convert the penny test into a depth figure [A03].
The fuel-saving page gives advice rather than legal requirements; its facts are labelled as recommendations, not rules.
No figure in these pages was taken from outside the manual; the tire pressure loss figure is stated as an upper bound, as printed.

corpus_stability.reason: The Minnesota Driver’s Manual prints a single edition line (June 2026) on its front cover and opens with a New laws and information chapter that collects recent changes in one place, with no sign of more than one rewrite per year in the selected pages.
